faces.note: UAP Space Scene V2 (Nov 10, 2026) - owner's V2 brief (20:27-20:28 EST) on the V1 living sky. Galaxies: faster spin, four arms stretched longer, drawn in overlapping layered passes so they read dimensional, and the whole galaxy breathes - grows with a pulse and recedes. THE POPULATION IS ORGANIC: spawning continuously adds ships (a spawn pressure, starting population 8, renderer ceiling 42); the sky fills until ships cannot help but meet - co-located ships squabble with laser fire and explode - or drift into a galaxy's heart and get the accretion toilet flush (caught, free-spinning, spiralling in). Deaths come in waves; the population crashes, then spawn pressure rebuilds it. No steering forces encounters; density does. Dense seeded starfield (420 stars). Menace aliens fly as a ship class. SHAPE IS BAKED AT PURCHASE - the owner's ruling: the V1 in-face shape buttons are gone (heavier app, dumb UX); the buyer chooses ROUND, RECTANGLE or SQUARE at the store and that build ships fitted; this file is the SQUARE build (one source, a single SHAPE constant, per-shape layouts computed from measured pixels, nothing stretched). Clock: digital in square/rectangle builds, analog hands on the centre POST PIN in the round build (Face Law 1). No compass bezel, so Law 2 has nothing to govern. Motion from first paint: no REST/observe governor, no auto-exit; dim-only battery overlay after 60 s idle. Real-render proof (Chromium 153, bench accel 12x labelled, clock checked at wall speed): clock exact (34 s over 34.15 s wall), over 417 sim-seconds the population ran 8 -> peak 15 -> crash to 9 -> rebuilding, with 159 combat events, 2,936 laser shots, 188 explosion deaths, 32 accretion captures (31 flushed); zero page exceptions; screenshots square/rectangle/round in the build record. faces.note: Wish Face (Nov 11, 2026) - Package Scope Inspector BUILD ORDER BO-5: the Wish Picker on the wrist. THE TEAM LAW (owner): the face tells time and carries the day's wish; the picker app and the results board are the working surfaces. A CARE face first: the Wish Picker's real purpose (owner, Nov 7, 2026) is Merry Pearson's daily schedule and anticipation - the seal at 17:17, the draws at 19:29, the grade in the evening. ENGINE: the Hierographic engine (Globe Tracker, Series 01, via The 19 / Cast Net) - big Casio readout (house DSEG7, hollow digits, OLED-black hearts, on a solid chip), the one-pulse-per-second trace with millisecond shimmer, ONE wireframe patrol drone with lock bracket / trail / TRK tag, Apex glyph edging, honest GPS line (real fix only, otherwise GPS - NO FIX; coordinates never invented), Apex Frame worn by default (FRAME ON/OFF; hollow even-odd rings, the glass genuinely open), DIM-ONLY overlay after 60 s idle; motion from first paint, no REST/OBSERVED governor. TWO READOUTS (the BO-2a pattern, the owner's options): DIGITAL (default) and HANDS - analog hands on the centre post pin (Face Law 1) drawn from the MONOTONIC SWEEP LAW (Scope Sweep Fix, Nov 11, 2026: wall-clock-seeded sweep time advanced only by real frame deltas clamped to 50 ms; a gap over 500 ms re-primes with one nominal 16.7 ms step; raw rAF timestamps never read as time). THE WISH LAYER reads ONE source - the house feed wish-results.json (production: https://tinyradr.com/wish/wish-results.json), the same cross-checked file the results board reads, fetched on load and every 60 s - and does NO arithmetic on the draw: the sealed set is copied from the feed's sealed block, every grade word is built only from the feed's computed grades block (grade.py), and the next-fixed-point line counts the labelled SCHEDULE (SEAL 17:17 / DRAW 19:29 / GRADE 20:47) without ever claiming a draw happened. DOUBLE PLAY IS STRUCTURAL (the Nov 8/9 lesson, BO-6): the Fantasy 5 and Powerball Double Play rows render from the grades block on every graded night, a WIN shows its computed prize in the board's words (Day 1: 'You won $7.00 on the Double Play'; Day 2: 'You won $2.00 on the Double Play'), NO WIN is stated plainly, and a missing row or a missing grades block stands as NOT GRADED in words - never silently skipped, never improvised. STATES, ALWAYS LABELLED: LIVE (feed fetched this session), LAST KNOWN - FEED UNREACHABLE (the last feed shown with its date, never posing as live), NOT POSTED YET (no feed ever seen - no numbers at all). NO PLATE hangs: the numbers are the picture. SQUARE build (shape-at-purchase). NO MEASURE: on-device rendering; the live feed over the real network path (the bench drives the layer with recorded Day 1 / Day 2 fixture feeds, labelled as fixtures); real GPS fix.

faces.note: The Sextant (Nov 16, 2026) - a navigation-instrument face in the Digiframe template line (folder B9): brass horizon dome, computed sun, moon and 20-star sky from the real clock and a named position input, sidereal time, and a fix labelled COMPUTED with its inputs named on the face. Position input: the device position when the host grants it (labelled GPS INPUT); otherwise the house default, Johannesburg, MI 44.981 N 84.496 W, labelled NO FIX - position is NO MEASURE until a field fix is compared against a known position, and the face says so. The math is shown in the readouts: the SUN, MOON and SKY UP lines carry altitude and azimuth as computed. Worked example, two independent workings filed with the build: 2026-11-16 15:00 UTC at the house position - the face's sun reads alt 18.39 / az 144.42 against an independent NOAA-form computation at 18.39 / 144.41 (arcminute class); the moon agrees with an independent Schlyter-form computation within half a degree across three instants, which is the compact lunar series' stated grade. No controls anywhere on the face; nothing in the bottom navigation band. Vanilla single file, real time driven off the frame clock.
faces.title: APEX — THE SEXTANT

faces.note: Radiosphere (Nov 16, 2026) - the signal-sphere face: the owner's bench proof of the same name (spinning sphere, height = strength, colour = plane) wired for production to the APEX SCAN FEED contract v1, the same contract Globe Tracker reads. The face paints ONLY what the shell publishes and re-reads the feed every frame: height is measured strength on the spec scale (h = 3 + (dBm + 95) x 30/65, floored at 2), colour is the plane (WIFI / BLE / RID / CELL / GNSS), width is a fixed footing stated on the face and never read as data, entries with no strength in the feed stand as footing dots and count as NO MEASURE, unknown planes are never plotted, and at most the 24 strongest are shown with the count stated on the face. Honest states hold in every build: SCAN - NO FEED (the web build has no shell and reports exactly that), SCAN - NO SIGNALS, and FEED STALE when the feed ages past 15 seconds. Receive-only: the face never connects, pairs, probes or transmits. No bench data ships in the production file. Vanilla single file; the clock rides the title box.
